title: Contractions of the relativistic quantum LCT group and the emergence of spacetime symmetries
summary: Advances in the study of relativistic quantum phase space have established the set of Linear Canonical Transformations (LCTs) as a candidate for the fundamental symmetry group associated with relativistic quantum physics. In this framework, for a spacetime of signature $(N_+,N_-)$, the symmetry of the relativistic quantum phase space is described by the LCT group, isomorphic to the symplectic Lie group $Sp(2N_+,2N_-)$, which preserves the canonical commutation relations (CCRs) and treats spacetime coordinates and momenta operators on an equal footing.
